title: cli: `objectui add COMPONENT` prints "Feature not implemented yet." and exits 0 — a documented command that writes nothing reads as success to a script
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named location and a measured reproduction, class (b).

`reach:` public entry, measured by objectui#11488's dev on the built CLI (dev report `5958059563` on objectui#11488, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). `node packages/cli/dist/cli.js add Input` printed three lines and wrote nothing (an empty temp dir), and it exited **0**:
- "Object UI Add: Input"
- "Feature not implemented yet."
- "This command will download the source code for InputRenderer to your project."

## Where (read by the seat at objectui `origin/main`)
- `packages/cli/src/commands/add.ts`: `add(component)` is the three `console.log` lines and nothing else.
- `packages/cli/src/cli.ts:185–190` wires `.command('add')` with "Add a new component renderer to your project" and `<component>`, calling `add()`.
- `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx:287–292` (`### objectui add <component>`) says "Add a new component renderer scaffold to your project." and shows `objectui add Input`.

## Same family
This is the third declared-but-unenforced CLI surface found today, after objectui#11476 (`generate --output`, retired, PR objectui#11487 landed) and objectui#11488 (`generate --from`, PR objectui#11495 in review). Both rulings were "declared means enforced: honour it or retire it" (triage `5955124315`, `5957399263`). This one is a whole command, not a flag.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
Honour it or retire it. On the two precedents, retiring removes the `add` command, `add.ts` and the docs section, with the built CLI refusing `add` as an unknown command. If the command is kept as a placeholder, it must at least exit non-zero. Pin either way with the built CLI.

Reader who acts: triage first (grade and ruling), then `domain:ui` (`packages/cli`, as objectui#11476 / objectui#11488). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Dedupe
- MCP issue search on objectui (objectui add component not implemented yet exit 0 renderer scaffold): 14 hits. None names `objectui add` or `commands/add.ts`; the nearest are unrelated renderer and type findings (objectui#11479, #10951, #10295).
- REST scan of the 900 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed: `objectui add`, `commands/add` or "not implemented yet": 0 cards about the command. The 3 hits are unrelated (objectui#11304, #11253, #11086).

Dedupe words: `objectui add not implemented yet exit 0` · `cli add component renderer scaffold no-op` · `commands/add.ts Feature not implemented yet`
